title: MarbDamageBalancer
body:
⚖️ marbDamageBalancer
The ultimate surgical tool for fine-tuning PvE combat difficulty.

Are your custom mobs hitting too hard? Or perhaps your high-tier armor makes the game too easy? marbDamageBalancer provides a lightweight, high-performance solution to balance damage dealt by mobs to players, ensuring a fair yet challenging experience.

✨ Key Features
Threshold-Based Scaling: Only modify hits that actually matter. Small scratches remain untouched, while "tank-buster" hits get balanced.

Smart Projectile Handling: Automatically detects and balances damage from arrows, tridents, and other projectiles fired by monsters.

Dynamic Reduction: Apply a percentage-based reduction (multiplier) to any damage exceeding your defined threshold.

Hard Damage Cap: Set a "Max Damage" ceiling to prevent players from being one-shotted, regardless of the mob's strength.

Multi-Language Support: Fully translatable messages. Includes built-in English and Polish localizations.

Bypass System: Want your admins or special ranks to remain unaffected? Simply grant them the bypass permission.

⚙️ How it Works
The plugin listens to damage events at HIGH priority. If a mob (or its projectile) deals damage above your min-damage-threshold, the plugin applies your reduction-multiplier and ensures the final value doesn't exceed your max-damage-cap.
